item.title: ❗️ Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Andrei Belousov awards the commander of corvette Soobrazitelny for competent and decisive actions in preventing provocation of Dani
item.description: ❗️ Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Andrei Belousov awards the commander of corvette Soobrazitelny for competent and decisive actions in preventing provocation of Danish Air Force helicopter in Baltic Sea. For skilful and decisive actions in preventing the provocation by a helicopter of the Air Force of Denmark, the commander of the corvette Soobrazitelny was awarded the medal 'For Combat Distinctions' by Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Andrei Belousov. On 14 September, at 14:22, the corvette Soobrazitelny of the Baltic Fleet performed tasks in neutral waters in the south-western part of the Baltic Sea, detected an aerial target identified as the Danish Air Force Fennec-type helicopter, which was approaching the Russian warship and did not respond to calls via the international channel. In order to prevent the provocation of the Danish helicopter, the commander of the corvette decided to launch two red light flares, after which the helicopter left the area of the Russian warship. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29442

❗️
Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Andrei Belousov awards the commander of corvette Soobrazitelny for competent and decisive actions in preventing provocation of Danish Air Force helicopter in Baltic Sea.
For skilful and decisive actions in preventing the provocation by a helicopter of the Air Force of Denmark, the commander of the corvette Soobrazitelny was awarded the medal 'For Combat Distinctions'
by Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Andrei Belousov.
On 14 September, at 14:22, the corvette Soobrazitelny of the Baltic Fleet performed tasks in neutral waters in the south-western part of the Baltic Sea, detected an aerial target identified as the Danish Air Force Fennec-type helicopter, which was approaching the Russian warship and did not respond to calls via the international channel.
In order to prevent the provocation of the Danish helicopter, the commander of the corvette decided to launch two red light flares, after which the helicopter left the area of the Russian warship.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

The Tsentr Group's units improved the tactical situation.
Russian elements inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, one airborne brigade, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, two marine brigades, and five national guard brigades close to Belozerskoye, Andreyevka, Novovodyanoye, Dobropolye, Novoyavlenka, and Gulevo (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU's losses amounted to more than 380 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, 13 motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station.
↗️
The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depth of the enemy's defence.
Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of one assault brigade, three air assault brigades, one assault regiment, one unmanned systems regiment of the AFU, and one marine brigade close to Kolomiytsy, Otrishki, Chaplino (Dnepropetrovsk region), Vasinovka, Vasilkovoye, Volnyanka, Omelnik, Samoylovka, and Nikolskoye (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The AFU lost more than 290 troops and eight motor vehicles.
📍
The Dnepr Group's units improved the situation along the front line.
Formations of one mechanised brigade, one mountain assault brigade and one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine have been hit near Orekhov, Kamyshevakha, Zaporozhets, and Yulyevka (Zaporozhye region).

Up to 40 troops, 11 motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station were neutralised.

item.title: 📍 The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29440

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
📍
Units of the Sever Group of Forces in Kharkov region continue to tighten the encirclement of the enemy's formations and expand the external control area.
💥
Combat operations
to liberate Malaya Volchya (Kharkov region)
continue in the encirclement ring. Russian elements inflicted losses on
manpower and hardware of the enemy close to Serdobino, Khripuny, and Buzovo (Kharkov region).
The AFU assault group's attempt to leave the encirclement
near Gogino (Kharkov region)
was thwarted
.
▪️
Over the past 24 hours, the enemy has lost up to 50 troops, two Western-made armoured fighting vehicles, one motor vehicle, and two ground robotic systems.
📊
Since the beginning of the month, more than 600 troops, 15 armoured fighting vehicles, nine motor vehicles, 13 ATVs, and 23 ground robotic systems have been neutralised in the encirclement ring.
🔥
During the external control area expansion,
strikes were delivered at
AFU formations close to Prikolotnoye, Petropavlovka, and Novoaleksandrovka (Kharkov region).
💥
In addition, in Kharkov region, strikes were delivered at
manpower and hardware of two tank brigades, one mechanised brigade, and one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine close to Maly Burluk, Korbiny Ivany, Rassokhovatoye, Varvarovka, Izbitskoye, and Rubezhnoye.
📍
In Sumy region,
units of two mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and two territorial defence brigades
were hit
near Tolstodubovo, Studenok, Krovnoye, Vakalovshchina, and Doroshovka.
▪️
In total, the enemy lost more than 220 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, nine motor vehicles, and one Grad MLRS vehicle in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group of Forces.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
Formations of four mechanised brigades, one assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, and one territorial defence brigade were hit close to Putnikovo, Petrovka, Izyum, Proletarskoye, Chervony Oskol (Kharkov region), Prishib, Sidorovo, Krymki, and Shchurovo (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy losses amounted to more than 210 troops, 12 motor vehicles, and two field artillery guns, including one UK-made 155-mm Braveheart self-propelled artillery system.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, one airmobile brigade, one mountain assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, and one territorial defence brigade near Slavyansk, Kramatorsk, Druzhkovka, Nikolayevka, Semenovka, and Vasilyevskaya Pustosh (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost more than 155 troops, 20 motor vehicles, and two field artillery guns.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

Russian Deputy Defence Minister Anna Tsivileva address 13th Beijing Xiangshan Forum
State Secretary – Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Anna Tsivileva took part in the 13th Beijing Xiangshan Forum.
🇷🇺
🇨🇳
The relationship between Russia and China is at an unprecedentedly high level and meets the key interests of the peoples of both states.
State Secretary - Deputy Russian Defence Minister Anna Tsivileva said that during the forum.
'Today, this respected discussion platform has gained particular importance.
The Forum has become the most important centre of attraction for those seeking an objective view of global processes and striving for dialogue
'.
🤝
Anna Tsivileva noted that
the Russian-Chinese comprehensive partnership and strategic interaction are dynamically developing
in all spheres, including in the field of military cooperation, based on the principles of equality, reciprocal support in key issues, mutual understanding and consideration of each other's interests. The Deputy Defence Minister of the Russian Federation expressed confidence that
such principles should be the base of a multipolar world order,
which, according to her, has already become a reality.
'
The multipolar world order
creates the conditions for strengthening the global security architecture and guaranteeing strategic stability – a key factor that will ensure development and prosperity in the world'.
💬
The interaction between the military agencies
of different countries should be aimed at creating conditions for the preservation of global and regional stability. Russia-China security cooperation in this context is important, Anna Tsivileva said.
▫️
Anna Tsivileva also noted that
the sphere of humanitarian cooperation and assistance to states affected by natural disasters or epidemics offer great opportunities for building confidence among all countries.
‘Russia is always ready to come to the aid of any country affected by natural disasters, catastrophes or epidemics’.
❗️
The Deputy Defence Minister stressed that
the priority must be given to dialogue and interaction at the level of all departments,
including defence agencies.
‘Russia has always been in favour of peaceful coexistence and the search for compromises. We are proposing to establish a just world order that takes into account the interests of all nations, and a dialogue between countries based on mutual respect and equality’.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
